title: The Flame Sword
speaker: X GOD
caption: The Dragon was beaten.
The Flame Sword was finally mine.
alt: X God claims the Flame Sword on the school rooftop while Dark Dragon lies defeated beside the freight crates.

title: The mark on the meteor
speaker: X GOD
caption: That mark... I'd seen it before.
It was carved into the meteor.
alt: X God recognizes the meteor's broken gold-circle mark on a blackened freight seal.

title: A familiar face
speaker: BARRETT
caption: X! You made it too!
I saw that mark on a Graveyard cart.
alt: X God and his surviving Earthior schoolmate Barrett greet each other with a friendly fist bump.

title: Toward the Graveyard
speaker: X GOD
caption: Then the Graveyard is our next stop.
We find answers. We find our friends.
alt: The school friends X God and Barrett set off together toward the distant moonlit Graveyard.
